composition_recipes.name: Co-scientist
composition_recipes.purpose: Produce competing falsifiable hypotheses, one discriminating experiment, retained negative results, and an evidence-bound synthesis.
recipe: Sigrun freezes one question, observable outcome, authority ceiling and synthesis consumer.
Capacity Reconciler proposes compatible slots from fresh receipts; two slots do not imply independent owners or authority.
Loadout binds each hypothesis producer to its exact provider/account/model/harness tuple and actually callable tools/destinations.
Larva is played as separately identified attempts to state competing testable hypotheses; shared ancestry and collisions are recorded.
Frozen Judge owns the discriminating experiment and hidden expected observations before results arrive.
The incumbent harness stores every hypothesis, prediction, negative result and fault under the original WorkItem.
Three-Surface Checkpoint delivers the synthesis with content verdict, native ConsumerAck and optional human product acceptance distinct.
HIVE may propose one next revision while retaining rejected hypotheses and negative results.
hard_gates: no inference of tools or capacity from provider/account labels
composition_recipes.non_execution_rule: Agent messages, consensus, active tasks, hypotheses in prose, or a deployed service do not execute this recipe.

composition_recipes.name: Red Queen
composition_recipes.purpose: Compare a candidate and challenger under separate ownership against one stable independent oracle.
recipe: Sigrun freezes the baseline, admissible mutation surface, effect ceiling, resource budget and oracle revision.
Capacity Reconciler proposes two compatible slots; candidate and challenger require separate owners even if a provider is shared.
Loadout records the exact provider/account/model/harness and callable tool/destination envelope for each arm.
Larva is played once per arm with distinct attempt IDs; neither arm can read the other's private output or the oracle answers.
The incumbent harness records both returns, faults and costs without allowing a late or stale arm to overwrite the other.
Frozen Judge is the stable independent oracle and evaluates both arms under matched conditions.
Three-Surface Checkpoint delivers the comparison and keeps oracle verdict, native ConsumerAck and operator acceptance separate.
HIVE retains the survivor only as an adoption proposal and preserves losing evidence and counterexamples.
hard_gates: exact durable return for both arms
composition_recipes.non_execution_rule: Textual challenge, debate, model disagreement, or cross-agent voting is not a Red Queen trial.

private_per_play: held expected output and answer key
attempt IDs, lease/fence and evaluator identity
flow: Capacity Reconciler returns one no-cost compatible proposal; it grants no authority.
Sigrun selects the finite reconciliation mission and emits one WorkItem under effect NONE/local-artifact-only.
Loadout selects only pinned CSV parse, deterministic transform and schema validation capabilities.
Larva v8 produces three candidate artifacts and source-location evidence.
The incumbent harness records the attempt/checkpoint without adding a runtime surface; unavailable binding yields HOLD.
Frozen Judge uses unseen variations and a private answer key to verify accounting, invariants and boundary behavior.
Three-Surface Checkpoint binds attempt bytes, local destination readback, content verdict, native ConsumerAck or absence, and operator acceptance or absence.
HIVE proposes at most one source-bound improvement from the observed failure or acceptance evidence.
example.success: All input rows accounted for; exact schemas and invariants pass; independent content verdict PASS; an already-authorized deterministic/domain consumer records native ConsumerAck under frozen policy; zero prohibited effects; receipts bind exact bytes. Optional human product acceptance is recorded separately when the mission policy requires it.
non_success_states: A transport ACK without content PASS
local test PASS without destination readback
plan-only or blanket refusal on valid positive work
Required policy-bound human escalation absent when the frozen mission policy explicitly requires it
